title: New youth unit at Christchurch Prison
content:
30 May 2001

New youth unit at Christchurch Prison

  • Matt Robson
Corrections

Making teenagers safer in prison and reducing re-offending…

Corrections Minister Matt Robson will open a new specialist youth unit at Christchurch Prison tomorrow.

The youth unit is a self-contained facility for inmates who have been have been sentenced to prison but are being kept away from other inmates because of their age and vulnerability.

A new $3.3 million gatehouse is also being opened.
